frequency_question: What proportion of announced technology-transfer and domestic missile manufacturing setups successfully achieve verified operational status within their target timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes: officially announced licensed production of major guided missile systems (e.g., Exocet, BrahMos, Storm Shadow derivatives, or similar tactical missiles) in a secondary state. Excludes: purely domestic indigenous designs without foreign tech transfer, and small arms/ammunition production.

cases.name: Pakistani Babur cruise missile domestic assembly
Taiwan Hsiung Feng III production lines
South Korea Hyunmoo licensed component manufacturing expansion
Saudi Arabia-China ballistic missile production facility (Al-Watah)

coverage_note: 5 named cases representing major recognized state-level transfers of complex missile manufacturing.
known_gaps: Classified or informal arrangements that lack public reputable defense press verification are omitted.
skeleton: Total verified missile tech-transfer programs meeting criteria divided by total attempted/announced programs under wartime or expedited conditions.
multiplier: 4 hits / 5 total documented major complex missile localization attempts = 80%
validity_reason: Defense industrial base constraints and geopolitical tech-transfer norms remain stable through the decade.
